create_test_prompts: create test prompts with SamplingParams and optional LoRARequest for offline inference
initialize_engine: initialize an LLMEngine with a model, quantization technique, and LoRA support enabled
process_requests: process a list of prompts through the engine and print finished outputs
run_lora_quantization_inference: run offline inference with LoRA combined with bitsandbytes, AWQ, or GPTQ quantization
main: run the full LoRA with quantization inference pipeline including cleanup between test configurations
